semantics.integerEncoding: BigInt with checked fixed-width arithmetic; usize/isize assume 64 bits

const fn is lowered for pure runtime calls only; compile-time evaluability is not established
Immutable strings encode scalar values; monomorphic tagged values encode Option/Result; vectors/slices are immutable arrays
semantics.observation: checked value results, local scalar mutation, immutable constructors, lazy future polling and named host effects; carried items supply no executable behavior
